name: rpi-dashboard
description: Islamic ASCII-art home screen dashboard for Raspberry Pi

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.check: npm run check -w apps/web && npm run check -w apps/server
scripts.art: node scripts/art/aqsa.mjs && node scripts/art/wedding.mjs && node scripts/art/couple.mjs && node scripts/art/horses.mjs
